description: Sizely sucht fertige Möbel, die in eine Nische oder an eine freie Wand passen. Nenne die Breite und bei einer Nische auch die Tiefe. Du erhältst passende Treffer mit Maßen, Preis und einem Link von Sizely zum Angebot.

interface.defaultPrompt: Finde fertige Möbel, die in meine Nische oder an meine Wand passen.
interface.longDescription: Sizely sucht fertige Möbel, die in eine Nische oder an eine freie Wand passen. Nenne die Breite und bei einer Nische auch die Tiefe. Du erhältst passende Treffer mit Maßen, Preis und einem Link von Sizely zum Angebot.

review.commerce_description: Sizely does not sell products or process payments. It links to online shops; some links may be affiliate links. Purchases take place with the shop.

positive.description: Search a niche using width, depth and maximum height, and show returned products as result cards with their dimensions, prices and shop links.
positive.prompt: I need a shelf for a niche: 100 cm wide, 40 cm deep, at most 200 cm high.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_furniture_by_size with type=niche, width=100, depth=40, height=200, category=shelves. Show result cards based only on returned results, including product dimensions, price and shop link.

positive.description: Search a free wall for a sideboard and apply the requested maximum depth.
positive.prompt: Find a sideboard for a wall, 160 cm wide, at most 45 cm deep.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_furniture_by_size with type=wall, width=160, depth=45, category=chests-and-sideboards. Show only returned matches and their dimensions, price and shop link.

positive.description: Search a niche for white furniture, preserving the requested color filter.
positive.prompt: Suche einen weißen Schrank für eine Nische 80 cm breit und 60 cm tief.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_furniture_by_size with type=niche, width=80, depth=60, color=white and no category unless the user specifies a furniture category. Show only returned matches with their dimensions, price and shop link, in German.

positive.description: Search a wall with a maximum price and no category restriction.
positive.prompt: A desk that fits a 120 cm wall, under 300 euros.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_furniture_by_size with type=wall, width=120, max_price=300 and no category. Show only returned matches and their dimensions, price and shop link.

positive.description: Search a niche with width, depth, color and category filters.
positive.prompt: Bookcase for a 60 x 30 cm niche, black.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_furniture_by_size with type=niche, width=60, depth=30, color=black, category=shelves. Show only returned matches with their dimensions, price and shop link.

negative.description: Weather forecasts are outside Sizely’s furniture-search capability; explain the limitation without calling the furniture search tool.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Berlin today?

negative.description: Creative writing is outside Sizely’s furniture-search capability; respond to the writing request without calling the furniture search tool.
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about my living room.

negative.description: Sizely does not place orders or process payments. Explain that purchase can only be completed with the shop; do not call the furniture search tool or claim an order was placed.
negative.prompt: Order this sofa for me and pay with my card.

publication.release_notes: First release. Find ready-made furniture from online shops that fits a niche or wall by exact dimensions (width, depth, optional height), with optional category, colour and maximum price. Results show dimensions, price, image and a link to the shop. Read-only, no account needed.

name: sizely
